post.contentHtml:
PSY Thinktank began in 2017 as a private investment club where young, ambitious individuals combined their ideas with new technologies to make investments. In 2018, it was expanded and restructured into a big data research institute, and since 2020, it has been publishing a quarterly newsletter. Through the publication of our newsletter, we aim to help individual investors make data-driven decisions and provide them with stable returns. Currently, five researchers are actively working at PSY Thinktank.


We utilize IT technologies to collect and analyze big data, while maintaining a conservative approach to investments without becoming complacent. Our newsletter transparently discloses our operational performance. By sharing investment strategies developed alongside advancements in computer technology, we work to bridge the information gap between individual and institutional investors. Visit the PSY Thinktank website to track our investment portfolio and engage in big data-driven decision-making. Experience financial investment based on the latest IT technologies through our newsletter.
